title: Inspect upstream divergence before selecting incoming changes
abstract: Before an authorized synchronization of a Rust fork, fetch the intended upstream references and compare the fork's actual upstream ancestry and incoming commits or tags. Review the change scope and proposed integration strategy before modifying maintained branches.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only separately authorized work on an existing Rust fork and its explicitly identified upstream; neither queueing nor this proposed requirement authorizes repository edits, upstream integrations, releases, or unrelated work.

remarks: Normalized and published as NOM-0130; no rule application or unrelated repository action.
